infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PlanIt uses the microphone for the walkie talkie so you can send voice messages to your plan.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PlanIt uses the camera so you can take a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PlanIt uses your photos for profile pictures, plan banners and the shared gallery.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PlanIt shares your live location with your plan when you enable the meetup tracker.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: PlanIt uses Face ID to unlock the app when you enable the biometric lock.
